C++ 
// CPP program to print stair case pattern.
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

// Function definition
void pattern(int n)
{
    // for loop for rows
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {

        // conditional operator
        int k = (i % 2 != 0) ? i + 1 : i;

        // according to value of k carry
        // out further operation
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
            cout << " * ";
        cout << endl;
    }
}

// Driver code
int main()
{
    int n = 6;
    pattern(n);
    return 0;
}

// C++ Program for Stair Case Patterns
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

// Function definition
void pattern(int n)
{
    // for loop for rows
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {

        // conditional operator
        int k = (i % 2 != 0) ? i + 1 : i;

        // for loop for printing spaces
        for (int g = n; g > k; g--)
            cout << " ";

        // according to value of k carry
        // out further operation
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
            cout << "* ";
        cout << endl;
    }
}

// Driver code
int main()
{
    int n = 6;
    pattern(n);
    return 0;
}
